about_the_game:
[Upcoming Features] DEMO Version Update Plan! Your Feedback is Shaping the Future! 🔥

New Multiplayer Mode - Squad up with friends for instant PvP action! Battle anytime, anywhere!
(In Development - Coming Soon!)

AI Overhaul - NPCs now predict and flank! Every strategy faces real-world counterplay!
(In Development - Coming Soon!)

Full Controller Support - HD rumble + console-grade responsiveness!
(In Development - Coming Soon!)

Tactical Depth Expanded - New terrains/interactive objects/deadly traps - Hunters AND prey get smarter!
(In Development - Coming Soon!)

⚠️ Current Version Notice
This DEMO only showcases core mechanics - think of it as our humble beginnings! Our dev team is crunching weekly updates. Wishlist now to follow our glow-up journey!

Click [Add to Wishlist] to become a Co-Creator! Every wishlist entry = rocket fuel for our development. Show us this project deserves your passion!

Drop your brainwaves here:

Battle Royale + Action Roguelike

When the bell tolls—

Hunt Mode: Become the Ebony Hunter and revel in the thrill of the chase.
Escape Countdown: Descend into the Pale Prey and endure the suffocating struggle to survive.
Cycle Unbroken: Each identity shift ignites a fresh battle for dominance.

Remember—your prey today may become your hunter tomorrow...

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-3240 (2 * 3400); AMD FX-4300 (4 * 3800)
  • Memory: 4 MB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 560 Ti (1024 VRAM); Radeon HD 7750 (1024 VRAM)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1500 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-3470
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1050 (2048 VRAM); Radeon R9 380 (2048 VRAM)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: Rogue Hunt & Deadly Reversal . BR meets roguelike! Swap roles when the Bell rings: Hunt as Black (dash/kill White) or flee as White (use traps/terrain). Every cycle reverses predator & prey. Survive endless role-flips in this lethal cat-and-mouse battle. Last alive wins!
supported_languages: English, Simplified Chinese, French, German, Russian, Japanese, Traditional Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Spanish - Latin America, Korean
